blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Trisha Tubu and the Farm Fresh Foxies got an eye-opener from defending champion Creamline before facing a tall order against the twice-to-beat No. 1 seed Nxled in the PVL All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series semifinals on Tuesday at Philsports Arena. Tubu played under the weather but still gave her all with 18 points and eight digs, only for Farm Fresh’s three-game winning streak to be snapped by Creamline and lose the last twice-to-beat bonus, 25-19, 25-18, 25-18, on Saturday. “Although it’s not an excuse, my mindset was that we’re already here, so whatever I’m feeling, I have to do […]...
